coverage_map.scope_or_acceptance_layer: Authorized custom-group departure: a current group member or active club admin may remove a member; self-removal and last-member removal are allowed.
Removal changes only custom-group membership: removing a club admin preserves their Admin role and management power, and every target remains an active club member.
Follow cleanup: departure clears manual and automatic group-conversation follows through public Messaging facts without touching unrelated groups or system-group behavior.
Rapid remove/re-add safety: stale cleanup cannot erase a newly established follow, re-add restores history but not former follows, and explicit follow-again restores notifications.
Immediate effective revocation: current authorization gates group/conversation reads, replies, follow actions, direct links, and already-open LiveViews.
Email boundary: no new private handoff occurs after known access loss, while already provider-handed-off or delivered copies are not recalled.
Member experience: group-specific Leave/Remove confirmations and restricted post-removal surfaces preserve shared rows, role labels, route context, focus, and the single action slot.
Empty-group lifecycle: the group, address, and history remain unchanged and listed; existing admin admission can repopulate it without a new lifecycle status.
Final verification: both approved acceptance surfaces, focused regressions, and the full repository check pass on the exact final state.
